<html><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="IE=edge" http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no" name="viewport"/>
<title>LionGroup: To all our valued customers</title>
<style>
body, html{
	font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif, "微軟正黑體";
	text-rendering: optimizeLegibility !important;
	-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased !important;
	color: #5a5a5a;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
}

header{
	width: 100%;
	height: 60px;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
	border-top: solid 3px #e10500;
}

.wrapper{
	max-width: 560px;
	width: 76%;
	height:inherit;
	padding: 30px 30px 90px 30px;
	border: solid 1px #DDDDDD;
	box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px #DDDDDD;
	margin-left: auto;
	margin-right: auto;
	position: relative;
}
.text_content{
	padding-top: 15px;
	padding-bottom: 60px;
}
.text_down{ text-align:right; }
.logo{
	width: 100%;
	padding-top: 0px;
	padding-right: 30px;
	text-align: right;
	position: absolute;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 20px;
	display: block;
}

/* RESPONSIVE CSS
-------------------------------------------------- */
@media screen and (orientation:landscape) and (max-width: 1024px) {
	header{
		height: 25px;
	}
	.wrapper{
		padding-top: 10px;
		padding-bottom: 60px;
	}
	.text_content{
		padding-top: 0;
		padding-bottom: 20px;
	}
	.logo{
		bottom: 2px;
	}
}
	</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
<div class="logo"></div>
</header>
<div class="wrapper">
<p>To all our valued customers:</p>
<p class="text_content">Unfortunately, our website is currently unavailable in most European countries.<br/>
We are committed to looking at options to identify technical compliance solutions that will provide all customers with our award-winning service.</p>
<p class="text_down">Yours sincerely,</p>
<p class="logo"><img alt="雄獅旅遊Lion Travel" height="auto" src="data:image/png;base64," width="165"/></p>
</div>
</body></html>
